recommendations.body: `CandidateReviewReplacement` in `plan_tool/roadmap_candidate_review.py` (step 4 “Accept answer-bound replacements only when their recomputed impact is contained by the initial disclosure and the admitted capsule”) makes `replacement_impact_atoms` and `replacement_impact_identity` required while retaining schema version 1, so pre-change gate-clean replacement evidence lacks required fields and cannot replay its existing replacement/seal lineage.
recommendations.suggested_action: make `CandidateReviewReplacement` and `_validate_replacement()` accept legacy gate-clean evidence without impact fields while requiring persisted, recomputed impact data for new and review-required replacements

recommendations.title: `record_reviewer_answer()`, `_store_replacement()`, and `seal_review()` in `plan_tool/roadmap_candidate_review.py` (step
recommendations.body: `record_reviewer_answer()`, `_store_replacement()`, and `seal_review()` in `plan_tool/roadmap_candidate_review.py` (step 4 “Accept answer-bound replacements only when their recomputed impact is contained by the initial disclosure and the admitted capsule”) do not recheck the accepted head at every stale-lineage write boundary; an answer can be persisted after the head moves, and replacement/seal publication can write after their earlier check but before generation replacement.
recommendations.suggested_action: fence review-required answer, replacement, and seal publication with `_require_review_required_predecessor_is_current()` immediately before the generation replacement boundary
